items.title: Voice sounds right again
items.body: Long sentences no longer turn into a crackly, radio-like voice with sounds that aren't in the text.

items.title: Clear voice on every turn
items.body: The AI's voice stays at full quality, and on headphones your Mac's microphone is used so AirPods stay clear.

items.title: Safer releases
items.body: Every release is now built, signed and notarized automatically.
